result.description: Twilio SendGrid: cloud email delivery platform (transactional and marketing email) with v3 REST API and SMTP relay.
result.auth_detail: API keys sent as Bearer token in Authorization header. No OAuth2 for third-party developers (OAuth only for partner/Twilio-reviewed integrations).
result.access_detail: Free plan discontinued; signup gives a 60-day free trial (100 emails/day, no credit card), then paid plan needed. Users bring own API keys.
result.api_notes: v3 REST API at api.sendgrid.com/v3: Mail Send, templates, contacts/lists, marketing campaigns, stats, suppressions, webhooks, API keys, subusers, etc. Also SMTP relay.
result.blocker: No permanent free tier: only a 60-day trial; users need paid plan long-term. API key auth only, no OAuth.

evidence.quote: To use an API key, include an `Authorization` header with the value `Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY_HERE>` in your request.
Sign up for a free trial—no credit card required
**Free trial** lets you send 100 emails/day for 60 days
